subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should this issue’s remaining work be limited to the owner-scoped live-orphan session visibility fix, or folded into the broader default-off “remember across conversations” product mode?
rationale: Both paths touch transcript visibility and privacy boundaries; automation can identify the remaining source gap, but it cannot decide the intended product scope for cross-conversation recall.

options.title: Land the narrow runtime fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 as the immediate bug fix while preserving existing visibility defaults and keeping the broader mode separate.

options.title: Fold into broader product mode
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99611 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100140 establishes the owner-controlled recall model.

options.title: Close as configuration-only
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the current docs/doctor gates are the complete supported behavior and live-orphan recall should remain denied.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow runtime fix
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92261 as the immediate bug fix while preserving existing visibility defaults and keeping the broader mode separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The broader maintainer-authored recall issue and PR make davemorin the clearest owner for the product/privacy scope choice.
